question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        d.driver_id,
        d.full_name,
        SUM(ds.points) as total_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers_ext d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    GROUP BY r.year, d.driver_id, d.full_name
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
constructor_names AS (
    SELECT 
        constructor_id,
        name as constructor_name
    FROM constructors_ext
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    dp.year,
    dp.full_name as driver_full_name,
    cn.constructor_name
FROM driver_points dp
JOIN constructor_points cp ON dp.year = cp.year
JOIN constructor_names cn ON cp.constructor_id = cn.constructor_id
WHERE dp.total_points = (
    SELECT MAX(total_points) FROM driver_points d2 WHERE d2.year = dp.year
)
AND cp.total_points = (
    SELECT MAX(total_points) FROM constructor_points c2 WHERE c2.year = cp.year
)
ORDER BY dp.year
